description: This file contains implementations of linear interpolation algorithms, including functions for calculating interpolated values, binary search, and lookup tables. It also includes some performance testing code and initialization routines.

classes.name: FastInterpolation
classes.description: A class for fast linear interpolation between two points, precomputing coefficients for efficient value computation.

methods.name: int needInterpolationLogging(void)
methods.description: Returns the current logging setting for interpolation.

methods.description: Constructs a FastInterpolation object, optionally with specified endpoints.

methods.description: Initializes the interpolation coefficients based on two points.

methods.description: Returns the interpolated value at a given x.

methods.description: Performs linear interpolation between two points with optional message context.

methods.description: Performs clamped linear interpolation outside the interval.

methods.name: int findIndexMsg(const char * msg,const float array[],int size,float value)
methods.description: Binary search returning the highest index with array element greater than or equal to a value, with message context.

methods.description: Wrapper around findIndexMsg with an empty message.

methods.name: float interpolate2d(const char * msg,float value,const float bin[],const float values[],int size)
methods.description: Performs 1D table lookup with linear interpolation between specified bins.

methods.description: Sets a value at a specific key in a correction curve.
